m4ri-mzd-mul.description: External M4RI mzd_init for A, x and y, bit-wise packing through mzd_write_bit, mzd_mul(y, A, x, 0), mzd_read_bit unpacking into a gf2 BitVec, and disposal of every owned mzd_t
m4ri-mzd-mul.rustflags: C -O3 -march=native -fPIC library build; Rust glue without a target-cpu override

m4ri-peer-gf2.description: One public BitMatrix::matvec on a fresh gf2 matrix and vector, with the returned BitVec allocated and released inside the measured call
